landing.subline: The industry’s first comprehensive platform to control your cloud, mobile and telecom costs, now with live analytics on every line, license, invoice and dispute.

content.loginSubtitle: Technology expense analytics for IT, finance and procurement: telecom, mobile, SaaS and cloud spend, zero-usage lines and licenses, invoice audit errors, disputes and credits recovered, with AI answers on live data.
content.loginCardSubtitle: Sign in to Tangoe One Expense Intelligence
content.loginDemoNoteHtml: Sign in with your username & password to continue.
content.analyticsSubtitle: Billed spend, zero-usage lines and licenses, invoice audit errors, disputes and credits recovered
content.spotterSubtitle: Ask questions of your Tangoe expense data in natural language.

inline.subtitleReady: Billed spend, zero-usage rate and billing error rate by business unit. Select a business unit to view its KPIs
inline.subtitleIdle: Billed spend, zero-usage rate and billing error rate across business units
inline.errorMsg: Unable to load business unit data.

sampleQuestions: Zero-usage rate by business unit by month for the last 12 months
Billing error rate by vendor for mobile last 6 months
Wasted spend by cost center last 90 days
Top 10 vendors by credits recovered this year
content.askWelcome: Ask me anything about Tangoe One: telecom, mobile, SaaS and cloud expense management, invoice audit and disputes, zero-usage lines and license optimization. Or ask about your own expense data and I will chart it live.
content.askEmptySub: Ask any analytical question about your technology expense data: billed spend, cost per line, zero-usage lines and wasted spend, roaming, billing errors, disputes and credits recovered. Answers come straight from your live data with an interactive chart you can drill into.

action.label: Reclaim line or license
action.subtitlePrefix: Lines and licenses billed with no usage in the last 30 days, idle longest first. Right-click a line and choose
action.subtitleSuffix: to cancel, suspend or reassign it and notify the cost-center owner.
action.modalLead: Pre-filled from the selected line. Choose what to do with it so the spend stops on the next invoice.

chatbot.welcome: Hi! I'm the Tangoe Assistant. Ask me about telecom, mobile, SaaS and cloud expense management, invoice audit and disputes, or ask a question about your expense data.
chatbot.overview: Tangoe pioneered technology expense management over 25 years ago. Tangoe One manages telecom, mobile, cloud and SaaS spend, audits invoices and pursues billing disputes, and runs the mobility lifecycle for enterprises in 206 countries.

content.upgradeReason: Upgrade to Tangoe One Expense Intelligence Premium to unlock drill-down, Ask Tangoe and downloads.
